parts:
Hi,

I just tried to find more info on this. It looks like there is a limit of 4096 (or multiples of it in R, this is bytes and not characters according to the link: https://community.rstudio.com/t/does-console-impose-an-upper-limit-on-the-length-of-strings/12872/4) for the length of commands.

 

If you cannot find a way to filter by some R script then the way to go forward would be to “split” the ind.list in smaller chunks and c(, ) them together e.g.

 

part1 <- c(first, half)

 

part2 <- c(second, halft)

 

complist <- c(part1, part2)

 

gl.keep.in(gl, ind.list=complist)

 

 

 

should work if part1 and part2 are within the limit, better to do something like:

 

index <- gl@other$ind.metrics$criteria #(a true false vector what to drop, TRUE=will be kept)  

 

keeplist <- indNames(gl)[index]   #creates the list of individuals to keep to be used with the gl.keep.ind function.

 

Cheers, Bernd
